narrative.northStar: The Swim Club on a Sunny Morning
narrative.overview: A bright warm deck, one big yellow sign for what's next, and lane ropes you count as you go. Each screen leads with one next thing; pool blue only means done.

rules.name: The Blue Means Done Rule
rules.body: Pool Blue is only for things that filled up or finished.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: At most one big coloured Field per screen.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No label or kicker above a heading.

dos: Do lead with one next action in a Field
Do show progress as filling floats
